procedural_matters: ESP 210172 was represented by Marc O’Connor Cabau.
The race committee was represented by Christina Buch (course race officer).
facts: ?During thesecond attempt to start race 2 for the yellow fleet, the conditions were 7 knots of wind withflat water and strong current pushing the boats to windward.
At the preparatory signal the race committee displayed the black flag.
The race committee did not move the pin-end mark after the preparatory signal.
ESP 210172 was starting near the starting vessel.
The race committee identified ESP 210172 in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last minute before the starting signal.
The race committee signalled a general recall after the starting signal and displayed the sail number of ESP 210172 on the race committee signal boat before the next warning signal.
ESP 210172 did not sail in race 2 and was scored BFD.
conclusions: There was neither an improper actionnor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements forredress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
